name: Iacopo Loliva: Between Heart and Hole
description: Performance artist Iacopo Loliva presents a three-day performance work exploring the body, space, and time. Loliva works with the concept of 'between' - the space between heart and hole - creating an experimental, body-based work. The piece runs over multiple days, suggesting an evolving or durational element that rewards sustained engagement and positions the artist as working at the intersection of performance art and conceptual practice.
